text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: What a magnificent run, Mihono Bourbon!
(Waaaaaaahhh--!)
Having run the race to the very end, Mihono Bourbon stood frozen amidst the roaring cheers.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Faint tightness in chest detected.
Commencing scan.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A sense of exhilaration, breathlessness,
a 'flutter' or a 'heart-thump'—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Analysis complete.
Confirmed maximum level 'Arousal State.'

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That was so close! Great race, Bourbon!

Starting with a tremendous cheer, the fans
began calling out one after another.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Both Teio and Bourbon gave it their all!
That was an incredible race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: To think you've climbed this far!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Tears confirmed in the fans' eyes.
Determining that they are likewise in an 'excited state.'"

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the courage, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see, so this is... what it feels like to 'inspire courage'.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...'Joy' detected and confirmed, Master.

After changing clothes and
stepping out of Tokyo Racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Thanks for today, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No, thank you. I was able to truly grasp such rare and valuable knowledge firsthand. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! What's with that? You're being so modest.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Not that! Geez, I was
really, really frustrated today!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san won. Yet,
are you feeling 'frustrated' rather than 'happy'?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well, because... I could feel firsthand just how incredible "Mihono Bourbon" really is!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: This kind of thing isn't about winning or losing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Still, it went way past frustration, it was
so much fun! It totally exceeded my expectations!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And so—

Tokai Teio looked up at Mihono Bourbon with sparkling,
yet somewhat daring eyes.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Let's face off again somewhere!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, very well.
See you then!

As Tokai Teio ran off with a wave,
Mihono Bourbon gave a small wave back in return.
